scope: 独立复核PA拓扑/卸载软件及watchdog r04与自有hw_server启动/释放脚本；离线mock，不操作真实Vitis、SDK、串口或板卡。

findings.evidence: PowerShell 7.6.5 evaluates this exact expression as one 145-character item; both legal command-line strings fail membership. Isolated starter mocks for quoted and unquoted forms each exit 1 at line 33 with 子进程身份或命令行不一致. The bad tcp::9999 variant is rejected as expected.
findings.impact: A valid owned hw_server process cannot produce OWNED_SERVER_READY, blocking the guarded run before SDK observation.
findings.closure: Construct and verify the two expected command-line strings as distinct array elements, then rerun both legal-form mocks and the bad-argument rejection mock against a newly frozen hash.

verified_results.name: watchdog_r04_offline_matrix
verified_results.result: 25 isolated scenarios passed their assertions: fast SDK exit with missing result receipt fails and closes the owned server; sampled live SDK without exit code fails, terminates only the mocked owned SDK and closes the server; SDK nonzero and launcher nonzero fail and clean up; malformed/missing/mismatched/failed receipt fields fail; valid all-zero launcher/SDK/entry receipt reports API_OBSERVATIONS_SAVED_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING and skips failure cleanup.

verified_results.name: server_closer_identity_boundary
verified_results.result: Mocked matching identity is stopped once; command-line or parent-PID drift is refused before Stop-Process. No real process API was allowed through the harness.

verified_results.name: server_starter_command_line_variants
verified_results.result: Both legal quoted and unquoted command lines are rejected (exit 1); invalid port variant is rejected (exit 0). This is finding S1.

verified_results.name: pa_topology_and_cleanup_focused_tests
verified_results.result: 10/10 focused offline tests passed, including exact PA topology, public SDK targets() reselection via official-source AST behavior, cleanup against refreshed APU identity, and delayed stack/cancel failure evidence.

verified_results.name: candidate_powershell_parse
verified_results.result: PowerShell 7.6.5 ParseFile reported zero errors for r04 watchdog, starter, and closer.

verified_results.name: upstream_inputs_manifest_check
verified_results.result: Checker ran and returned exit 2 because the frozen topology delivery manifest records existing dependency FAIL/NOT_RUN rows (including historical sandbox/mock failures and not-run hardware validation). These rows are retained as upstream history and do not establish a failure in this review's current source.

limitations: No real Vitis, SDK, hw_server, serial port, FPGA, or board was operated; all process, WMI, port, start, and stop behavior in launcher tests was mocked.
API_OBSERVATIONS_SAVED_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING is software-runner success only; it does not satisfy G3/G4 or prove cold lifecycle behavior.
The inputs checker is blocked by the referenced upstream manifest's preserved historical failed/not-run checks.
